slot.brief: Use differentials to approximate the value of a root/surd like √(26) or cube root of a nearby perfect number; compute the error estimate dy.

stem: Using differentials, the approximate value of $\sqrt{26}$ is
working:
$y=\sqrt{x}$; at $x=25$, $y=5$ and $dy=\dfrac{dx}{2\sqrt{x}}=\dfrac{1}{10}$. Thus $\sqrt{26}\approx 5+0.1=5.1$.

Independent check: Using f(x)=√x near x=25: √26≈√25+(26−25)/(2√25)=5+0.1=5.1.
